newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian may have to live with knife in brain.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian may have to live with knife in brain.

text.p: A Brazilian man has spent 10 days in hospital with a knife lodged in his brain and doctors say they may not be able to remove it, Globo television reported on Saturday.
Construction worker Sidney de Queiroz was conscious but paralysed on the right side of his body after being stabbed between his right eye and the bridge of his nose during a bar brawl, Globo said.

An X-ray image showed the blade, five inches (13 cm) long and less than an inch (two cm) wide at its base, clearly visible inside his skull. Globo said the doctors at the hospital in Sorocaba, in Sao Paulo state, may opt to leave the knife where it is.
